questionText: How does Spring Boot implement a REST API?

target.learningOutcome: The learner can explain the complete path from an HTTP request through Spring MVC to application code and back to a correct HTTP response, then build a minimal example.
inScope: Spring Boot web setup and auto-configuration
The Spring Boot application entry point and component-scan boundary
Spring MVC controller mappings and request binding
Validation, status codes, response headers, and exception mapping
prerequisites: Basic HTTP methods and status codes

claims.statement: With the Spring Web starter, Spring Boot configures the web application foundation and starts an embedded servlet container by default.
Spring MVC maps a request to an annotated controller method and resolves method arguments from the path, query string, headers, and request body.
Spring MVC uses configured HTTP message converters, commonly Jackson in a Spring Boot web application, to read JSON into Java values and write Java values as JSON.
A successful create endpoint can return 201 Created and a Location header identifying the newly created resource.
Bean Validation constraints run at the MVC boundary only when validation support is present and validation is triggered for the controller argument, for example with @Valid.
Throwing an application exception does not automatically guarantee a 404 response; the application must map that failure to the intended HTTP status.
